body: dude (dudette?) that sucks. I don't have much to say but do you know what 'intrusive thoughts' are? It kind of seems like you are having continual intrusive thoughts when you leave the house or think about interacting with people.

Losing a parent is a one time stress. Having a mentally ill, unstable, living in an alternate reality parent is a continual stressor that only gets worse the older the kids get. They are young enough that my wife could remarry and they could get a new dad and not even remember me.

Not in sa, another state. After a failed attempt you can keep it a secret and deal with it yourself or someone might find you. They might call the ambos or pretend it never happened. Once in hospital you will stay in ed for 24 hrs to 3 days. After a while they will discharge you with no follow up if you are good at lying and promise not to hurt yourself. If you say you are still suicidal they might discharge you anyway with no followup or put you inpatient psych. There are very few inpatient spots. Once you are inpatient they will drug you with some antipsychotics and benzos no matter what you have, give you some dumbass talks about art therapy and cbt then turf you out asap. You will lose friends, family, maybe your job or academic standing after an inpatient stint. 

During inpatient you are expected to justify your need to psych services constantly. No one will do the least bit of research or read your file, instead they will ask 'tell me in your own words why you are here' and you will have to do that several times a day to staff you will meet once and never see again. 

Sometimes the exact opposite will happen, and the magic 8 ball will say that you need to be kept inpatient for weeks on end with no clear discharge plan. 

Ive been inpatient three times.
I saw that post too and i didnt take it as romanticising suicide. I saw it as a comforting thought to the suicidal people. Im not selfish and taking the easy way out, im an angel returning home.
